title: Hospital sepsis: a communicable disease
creator_credit: Churchill-Wexler Film Productions and Johnson and Johnson
brief_description: Reaffirms the need for stringent precautions against infection in hospitals in face of the present over-reliance on antibiotics. After briefly tracing the history of anti-sepsis in hospitals, a detailed case study of the spread of bacteria from an infected patient pinpoints the major spreaders, reservoirs and multipliers or organisms.
